scope: Complete sourced Retail theme art and native presentation, based on four-size six-game presentation, all sixteen source/native poses, recorded live timing and production-path lifecycle evidence. No continuous audiovisual playback, browser export, real microphone, curriculum or module approval.
decision_evidence: Independent source sixteen-pose contact and native-phone sixteen-frame contact review
Independent full-scene and all four target-size actual Main six-game presentation review
Recorded live native motion timing, reduced-motion rest, hidden pause, crossfade and consumer teardown
Independent inspection of both new production-path rest images
Independent inspection of verifier/integration scripts, exact copy/provenance/log/script hashes, 355 protected data files and protected profile fields
excluded_claims: Real microphone or speech recognition review
Linguistic, domain, morphology or term-media approval
